findings.title: OS Command Injection in Ping Tool (/ping)
findings.description: The Flask Ping Tool passes user-supplied input from the `ip_address` POST parameter directly into an OS shell command without sanitization. An attacker can append arbitrary shell commands using semicolons (`;`) or other shell metacharacters, achieving full Remote Code Execution (RCE) on the server.
